items.title: Cloudflare 推出 Agent Memory：面向 AI 智能体的持久记忆托管服务
items.raw_excerpt: Cloudflare 推出托管服务 Agent Memory 并开启私测，可从AI智能体对话提取结构化记忆，通过五通道并行检索与倒数排名融合技术按需调取，还支持智能体团队共享记忆知识库，目前已有多款同类竞品。

title_i18n.zh: Cloudflare 推出 Agent Memory：面向 AI 智能体的持久记忆托管服务
title_i18n.en: Cloudflare launches Agent Memory: a persistent memory hosting service for AI agents.
title_i18n.es: Cloudflare lanza Agent Memory: un servicio de memoria persistente para agentes de IA.

excerpt_i18n.zh: Cloudflare 推出托管服务 Agent Memory 并开启私测，可从AI智能体对话提取结构化记忆，通过五通道并行检索与倒数排名融合技术按需调取，还支持智能体团队共享记忆知识库，目前已有多款同类竞品。
excerpt_i18n.en: Cloudflare has launched its managed service Agent Memory and opened private beta testing. It can extract structured memories from AI agent conversations, retrieve them on demand through five-channel parallel retrieval and reciprocal rank fusion technology, and also supports shared memory knowledge bases for agent teams. There are already several competing products on the market.
excerpt_i18n.es: Cloudflare ha lanzado el servicio gestionado Agent Memory y ha iniciado pruebas privadas. Este servicio puede extraer recuerdos estructurados de las conversaciones de agentes de IA, recuperándolos bajo demanda mediante una búsqueda paralela de cinco canales y una tecnología de fusión de clasificación inversa. También admite una base de conocimientos de memoria compartida para equipos de agentes. Actualmente, ya existen varios competidores similares en el mercado.

items.title: Stigmem – open-source federated knowledge fabric for AI agents (v1.0)
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN I'm one of the authors of Stigmem. Stigmem is an open-source specification and reference node for a shared, federated knowledge substrate for AI agents. The core idea: instead of agents maintaining isolated memory stores, they write typed, provenance-tagged facts into a shared substrate that replicates across nodes via Ed25519-signed peer handshakes. A fact is a seven-tuple: (entity, relation, value, source, timestamp, confidence, scope). Facts are immutable, contradictions surface as first-class conflict records, not silent overwrites. Each fact carries a Hybrid Logical Clock timestamp so ordering is consistent across distributed nodes without a central coordinator. v1.0 is spec-complete (all 18 sections stable).
